provenance: Receipt saved from the completed independent read-only check; measured values below are the actual prior tool output, not inferred from the renderer. Exact execution time was not recorded.
auditor: Independent sky_review sub-agent; no mixing-script or media edits
script_note: Preserves the exact executed check logic, with a module description and formatting added when saving. Emits JSON to stdout only.

input_format.comparison: numpy.array_equal; exact sample values, no tolerance

limitations: Checks the completed rendered PCM caches; it does not independently reconstruct music cuts, source gains, envelopes or SFX synthesis from original sources.
Does not decode or compare exported FLAC/MP3 files. Those full-output-to-rendered-reference checks are performed separately by build_mix.py and recorded in delivery-validation.json.
The final-zero result applies to the audited PCM caches. Lossy MP3 encoding can produce a nonzero final decoded sample.
No source or cache content hashes were captured during this independent check; the actual input paths and observed arithmetic results are recorded without a retrospective hash claim.
No listening, perceived-balance judgment, harmonic-compatibility judgment or user approval is inferred.
